title: Bookings: Sell Tours, Rooms and Appointments by Date | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A tour, a room and an appointment are sold for a date, and each date has room for a limited number of people. The CrestApps Bookings module sells all three from your Orchard Core store: seats per departure, rooms by the night, appointments by the hour, prices per person or per room, a deposit with the rest charged later, cancellation policies, requests you confirm first, travelers' details, and a list and calendar of everything that is booked.

In this video:
• Why bookings, and the three kinds of booking
• Making a product a booking: capacity, options and price per person
• Managing a tour's dates, seats and prices
• Nights and times: minimum stays, weekend prices, opening hours and slots
• Deposits, cancellation policies, requests and travelers' details
• What buyers see, and the Find a date page
• The bookings list and calendar
• Managing a booking: confirm, complete, no-show and cancel
• Use cases
